# Aruform - Existential Journaling App

## Project Overview
A Next.js TypeScript web application for existential journaling.

## Progress Checklist

- [x] Create copilot-instructions.md file
- [x] Scaffold Next.js project structure
- [x] Customize for journaling app
- [x] Install dependencies
- [x] Create and run dev task
- [x] Update documentation

## Development Notes
- Framework: Next.js 15 with App Router
- Language: TypeScript
- Styling: Tailwind CSS
- Storage: LocalStorage (client-side)
- Purpose: Existential journaling web application

## Project Structure
- `/src/app/page.tsx` - Landing page
- `/src/app/write/page.tsx` - Writing interface
- `/src/app/entries/page.tsx` - View entries
- `/src/app/layout.tsx` - Root layout
- `/src/app/globals.css` - Global styles

## Available Scripts
- `npm run dev` - Start development server
- `npm run build` - Build for production
- `npm start` - Start production server
- `npm run lint` - Run ESLint

## Features Implemented
- Landing page with introduction to existential journaling
- Writing interface for creating new entries
- Entries page to view and delete past entries
- Responsive design with dark mode support
- Local browser storage for entries
